did.unittitle: Office of the Messrs. Rockefeller records, Greenrock, Series V

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open for research. Brittle or damaged items are available at the discretion of RAC.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Greenrock Corporation served to manage and maintain the properties, facilities, homes, and grounds of the Rockefeller family estates in Maine and New York. Contents include but are not necessarily limited to: Greenrock Corporation budgets, real estate and property records in Maine and New York, particularly Seal Harbor and Pocantico Hills; land purchases and sales, renovations, documentation of Hills Realty, Co. Inc.; and Mount Desert Development Corporation (MDDC) project files.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: The Greenrock series is arranged in three subseries as follows: 1. Charles Keppel files. 2. William Denton files. 3. Accession 1991. Within each subseries the records remain in original order, as received.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: Expedited Access - Processing Level 1 - File-Level Access.
Records remain in original housing. Additional processing will be conducted in the future to improve description, enhance access, and long-term preservation.
